# Hub v2 V3: Commit

Step 3 of 7 of Hub v2. Needs V1 and V2. Read PROJECT-BRIEF.md first (the standing rule about git and the paths never to commit). No model call anywhere in this step's code. Hub files only.

## Goal
The owner says "commit" to the master, or opens Commit at the foot of the tree. The hub proposes ONE batch commit: every file changed since the last commit, minus the forbidden paths, with a message. The hub commits only after the owner presses the button, every time. A script does it; no model.

## Build
1. `hub/commit.js` (pure, tested): `FORBIDDEN = ['assets-src/', '.claude/', '.hub/', '.dev.vars', 'simproject.code-workspace']` plus any file named `.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`; `parseStatus(porcelainZ)` (added, changed, deleted, renamed, untracked); `buildProposal({status, runs, lastTest, plans, head})` returns `{files (grouped: Game, Tests, Hub, Plans, Notes, Other), leftOut, warnings, suggestedMessage, hash}`. Warnings, not blocks: tests have not passed since the newest file change; a file over 5 MB; files flagged by a run that is not Finished (unticked by default). `suggestedMessage` is made by script from the titles of the steps finished since the last commit. `hash` covers the status and the head commit.
2. `hub/git.mjs`: find GitHub Desktop's git (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\GitHubDesktop\app-*\resources\app\git\cmd\git.exe`, newest `app-*`), run it with `execFile`, no shell, in the repo root. Only these commands exist in the file: `status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all`, `rev-parse --short HEAD`, `log -5 --format=...`, `add -- <paths>`, `commit -F <temp file>`, and for undo `reset --soft HEAD~1` and `branch -r --contains HEAD`. Never `add -A`, `--amend`, `push`, `--force`, `--no-verify`, `reset --hard`, `clean` or `checkout`. Every path is checked against the proposal's own list and the forbidden list before it reaches git.
3. Routes (hub token, POST + JSON + same Origin, 64 KB, only with `--runs`): `GET /api/commit/proposal`; `POST /api/commit {files, message, hash}`: refused while a run, a chat turn or a job is active, refused with 409 when the tree or head no longer matches `hash` (answer with the fresh proposal), refused when `files` holds a path that is not in the proposal or is forbidden, message 1 to 2,000 characters. Answers with the new short commit id. `POST /api/commit/undo`: allowed only when HEAD is the commit this hub made last and no remote branch contains it; runs the soft reset, which keeps every file as it is.
4. Commit page (foot row `commit`, label "Commit · N files changed"): the "Next step" line, the test result pill with a "Run tests" button (V2 job), the message box, the grouped file list with tick boxes, "Left out, never committed" shown struck through and not tickable, "Commit N files", Cancel, and after a commit "Committed as <id>" with "Undo this commit, keep the files". No push control: pushing is the owner's open decision and stays in GitHub Desktop.
5. Master: add `commit` to `CHAT_OPS` (button "Review commit (N files)" that opens the Commit page; it never commits by itself). A reply may end with a line containing only `COMMIT:` followed by the message (kept to 2,000 characters, shown escaped in the message box, editable). `hub/status.js` adds "Changes since the last commit: N files" with the group counts and the last commit id, never file contents. `MASTER_RULES` explains both in the same style as PLAN: and ACTION:.
6. Remove the sentence "the hub never commits or pushes" where the hub's own notes say it, replacing it with "the hub commits only on the owner's press and never pushes". Runs keep their rule: never use git.
7. Tests: `tests/hub-commit.mjs` (status parsing including renames and paths with spaces, forbidden paths can never be chosen, warnings, 409 on a stale hash, message limits, undo rules) using a temporary repository made with the found git; when git is not found the git part reports "skipped: git not found" and the pure tests still run. Server tests: token required, busy refused, foreign path refused. Add a Commit screenshot to `scripts/hub-shots.mjs`.

## Rules
- The tests must never commit in the real repository: temporary folders only.
- No BOM. Run `npm test` after each change; finish with `npm run index`, then `npm test`. Stop with tests passing; report failures honestly. Do not commit, and do not press the new button on the real repository.

## Done when
The Commit page shows the true list and a message, the forbidden paths cannot be committed, the press makes exactly one commit of exactly the ticked files, a changed tree is refused, undo keeps all files, and each refusal has a test.

## Run
model: sonnet
why: builds a guarded git script and its page against tests
size: S
needs: test, check, index

Never `add -A`, `--amend`, `--force`, `--force-with-lease`, `fetch`, `pull`, `merge`, `rebase`, `--no-verify`, `reset --hard`, `clean` or `checkout`. Every path is checked against the proposal's own list and the forbidden list before it reaches git.
3. Routes (hub token, POST + JSON + same Origin, 64 KB, only with `--runs`): `GET /api/commit/proposal`; `POST /api/commit {files, message, hash}`: refused while a run, a chat turn or a job is active, refused with 409 when the tree or head no longer matches `hash` (answer with the fresh proposal), refused when `files` holds a path that is not in the proposal or is forbidden, message 1 to 2,000 characters. 4b. Push (decided by the owner, 2026-11-11: separate from Commit, both in the hub). On the same page, its own card: "N commits are not on GitHub yet" with their ids and first lines, and its own button "Push N commits to GitHub". Committing never pushes; pushing needs its own press every time. `GET /api/push/status`; `POST /api/push {head}` (hub token; refused while anything is working; 409 when HEAD is no longer `head`). When GitHub refuses because it has newer commits, or the sign-in fails, say so in plain words and point to GitHub Desktop; the hub never fetches, pulls, merges or forces. After a push, Undo for those commits is gone.
5. Master: add `commit` to `CHAT_OPS` (button "Review commit (N files)" that opens the Commit page; it never commits by itself). A reply may end with a line containing only `COMMIT:` followed by the message (kept to 2,000 characters, shown escaped in the message box, editable). `hub/status.js` adds "Changes since the last commit: N files" with the group counts and the last commit id, never file contents. `MASTER_RULES` explains both in the same style as PLAN: and ACTION:.
6. Remove the sentence "the hub never commits or pushes" where the hub's own notes say it, replacing it with "the hub commits and pushes only on the owner's press, each with its own button". Add `push` to `CHAT_OPS` the same way as `commit`: the button opens the page, it never pushes by itself. Runs keep their rule: never use git.
7. Tests: `tests/hub-commit.mjs` (status parsing including renames and paths with spaces, forbidden paths can never be chosen, warnings, 409 on a stale hash, message limits, undo rules) using a temporary repository made with the found git; when git is not found the git part reports "skipped: git not found" and the pure tests still run. Server tests: token required, busy refused, foreign path refused. Add a Commit screenshot to `scripts/hub-shots.mjs`.

## Rules
- The tests must never commit or push in the real repository: temporary folders only, with a local bare repository standing in for GitHub (push works, push is refused when the stand-in is ahead, undo is refused after a push).
- Whether GitHub Desktop's git can sign in to GitHub when the hub starts it is NOT known: do not try it on the real repository; say so in the result.
- No BOM. Run `npm test` after each change; finish with `npm run index`, then `npm test`. Stop with tests passing; report failures honestly. Do not commit, and do not press the new button on the real repository.

## Done when
The Commit page shows the true list and a message, the forbidden paths cannot be committed, the press makes exactly one commit of exactly the ticked files, a changed tree is refused, undo keeps all files, and each refusal has a test.
